name: Hotel Hirschen
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Hotel Hirschen is located in the center of Reith bei Seefeld and is traditionally furnished in the style of Tirol. The house combines alpine coziness with modern comfort. Guests can look forward to a traditional cuisine with regional dishes as well as a area with a Finnish sauna and steam bath. The Wildspitz Arena for slope fun and the Skigebiet Olympiaregion Seefeld ski resort can be reached in just a few minutes. The hotel is suitable for both winter vacations and summer stays in the Ötztaler Alpen.
